THREAT ASSESSMENT

THE MONEY
THEY'RE HIDING

Every platform has reporting gaps. Most creators never know what they're owed.

THREAT-01
Algorithmic Revenue Suppression
Views don't always equal payouts. Platform algorithms create phantom revenue that appears in analytics but vanishes from your bank account.
THREAT-02
Multi-Platform Reconciliation Gaps
Managing Kick, Twitch, YouTube and OnlyFans simultaneously? Discrepancies compound silently across every revenue stream.
THREAT-03
Subscription & Chargeback Fog
Chargebacks, refunds, and failed payments are reported differently across platforms. You're likely losing 3–12% to reconciliation failures.
THREAT-04
Currency & FX Ghost Losses
International supporters? Conversion discrepancies create invisible losses. Platforms convert at rates favorable to them.
THREAT-05
Delayed Payout Misattribution
Revenue earned in one period pays out 30–90 days later under different accounting rules. Most creators can't track the delta.
THREAT-06
Tax & Withholding Errors
Platform withholding calculations are frequently wrong. Without a reconciliation engine, you're either overpaying or under-reporting.
